items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Dewey and Bichet. And Bichet found out Dewey was getting more than he was. He quit.

ctx.x: At the Deluxe. And everything went all right until they got the paychecks mixed up one night. Dewey and Bichet. And Bichet found out Dewey was getting more than he was. He quit.
